title: slider intensity grade
rule: Slider = intensity/grade (volume, brightness, saturation) when a precise number is not required; pair NumberInput with Slider when precision is required.
pass_when: Slider is used for intensity/grade without a required precise number; precision uses Slider + NumberInput.
fail_when: Slider as the only control when a precise number is required; or slider for a non-intensity discrete choice.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: GOV.UK "don't use range sliders" on question pages as a winner; MUI/Apple number-entry dual-cite as this slider row.
